[[File:Larran's key detail.png|left|150px]]
'''Larran's key''' is a key obtained from killing monsters while on a [[Slayer task]] given by [[Krystilia]]. It is used to open [[Larran]]'s [[Larran's small chest|small]] and [[Larran's big chest|big chests]].

The exact odds of receiving a key scales with the monster's [[Combat level]]. For levels 1-80, the probability follows a curve between 1/1972 at level 1 to 1/100 at level 80.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1152237123778555904|date=19 July 2019|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/102151|archivedate=19 July 2019|quote=NPC combat levels 1-80: 1 in (100 + floor((3 / 10) x (80 - level) x (80 - level))).}} For levels 81 or higher, the odds are between 1/99 and 1/50, scaling linearly and capping at level 350, as reflected in the equation below.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1152237123778555904|date=19 July 2019|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/102151|archivedate=19 July 2019|quote=NPC combat levels 81-350+: 1 in (50 + number scaled linearly between 99 at level 81 and 50 at level 350)}}

If it concerns a [[Slayer monsters|Slayer monster]] (meaning it requires a certain Slayer level to kill), the drop chance is increased by 20%.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1152237123778555904|date=19 July 2019|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/102151|archivedate=19 July 2019|quote=If the NPC's Slayer req >= 2, multiply chance by 25%.}}{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1702377755403264342|date=14 September 2023|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/UwET0{{^|https://archive.ph/Ytbb0}}{{^|https://archive.ph/BXPOJ}}|archivedate=15 September 2023|quote=It's 20% for the Slayer req rather than 25%. (...)}} In addition, any monster killed within the [[Wilderness Slayer Cave]] has a further 15% increased chance to drop a key.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1326275335969796096|date=11 November 2020|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/107022|archivedate=10 November 2020|quote=15%}} [[Superior slayer monster]]s that spawn as part of Krystilia's tasks will always drop a key on death.

The probability <math>P</math> of obtaining a key when killing a monster with combat level <math>L</math> is given by: 
<math>P = \begin{cases} \frac{1}{\left \lfloor \frac{3}{10} \times (80 - L)^2 \right\rfloor + 100} &\text{if } L\in (0,80] \\  \frac{1}{\left \lfloor-\frac{5}{27} \times L \right\rfloor + 115} &\text{if } L \in (80, 350] \\ \frac{1}{50} & L\in (350,\infty) \end{cases}</math>

Larran's keys are <b>always</b> dropped on player death, even if there are fewer than 3 [[Items Kept on Death|items kept on death]]. If killed by another player, keys are lost to the killer. If killed in PvM, the keys always go to your [[gravestone]].
